theorems.name: Submission.ts_stronglyMeasurable_paste_continuousOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (N : ℕ → Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (G : ℕ → Ambient n ℓ → (Ambient n ℓ →L[ℝ] Ambient n ℓ)), (∀ i, MeasurableSet (N i)) → (∀ i, ContinuousOn (G i) (N i)) → ∃ g : Ambient n ℓ → (Ambient n ℓ →L[ℝ] Ambient n ℓ), StronglyMeasurable g ∧ ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ N i, (∀ j < i, y ∉ N j) → g y = G i y
